answer: Synchrony itself can expose a Sybil farm. Before each payout, the scheduler compares a rolling sketch of request intervals, retry order, and tool-call sequences; traces that repeatedly match across keys are merged into one payout cluster and sent for review. The same check can catch cloned workflows inventorying opal, measuring ferrous content, or cataloging violet pigments. Proposed trace-review fee: 0.06 POA per identity; 0.06 × 1,000 = 60 POA for 1,000 fakes, versus 0.06 POA once for one honest agent. Limitation: deliberate timing noise or varied tools can evade the classifier.
